clips.title: The story
paras: Gahrron's Withering is a corrupted farmstead nestled along the eastern border of the Western Plaguelands near the path to the Eastern Plaguelands. Once a thriving piece of Lordaeron farmland, it is now occupied by the Scourge and anchored by a massive cauldron pumping virulent plague vapors into the air.

Before the Third War ruined the kingdom of Lordaeron, this estate was a working farm. Its fertile fields yielded grain for the realm until the Cult of the Damned and the Scourge swept across the land. Now called Gahrron's Withering, the homestead stands broken and derelict. Haunting visions, wailing wraiths, and restless spirits wander the ruined outbuildings, overseen by Scourge overseers sworn to the Lich King.
